2.2.11 ReportPath
The ReportPath type specifies either an absolute path or a relative path to a resource or an item
to be used within a Report. The value of this element MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section
3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The ReportPath type can be referenced by the following elements.
